newsitem.title: UK: NWE gasoline ends marginally up but arb turns sour.
newsitem.headline: NWE gasoline ends marginally up but arb turns sour.

text.p: NWE gasoline prices ended slightly higher on Friday but the arbitrage appeared to sour for most sellers and local demand was sluggish.
"It's not quite workable for the States," said one broker.
A major who was trying to sell a cargo into NWE looks set to send it trans-Atlantic, but for its own needs there, he said.
Eurograde barges ended up $1 at $219/$221 fob ARA with the last trade heard done at $219.50 for Rotterdam refinery material.
Trading in regular unleaded was nearly non-existent but prices still held $5 below premium at $214/$216.

"Basically in the barges it's holding $5 below Eurograde but there is not a drop to be found," the broker said. "Indications in the cargo market are up to $216 on a fob basis but deals aren't getting done."
